CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2015 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2015 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 599 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: March 2015 to March 2015). These surveys captured 79 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 6 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 502 cards across 44 sites, with 7% showing evidence of mouse activity (35 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 100 transects across 44 sites (survey period: March 2015 to March 2015), detecting active burrows in 21% of transects (total: 61 active burrows).
